:::{#exm-partition}
#### Partitioning the die roll

In @exm-sample-space,
the events "the roll is even", $\set{2, 4, 6}$,
and "the roll is odd", $\set{1, 3, 5}$,
are mutually exclusive, and their union is $\samplespace$,
so they partition the sample space.
So do the six single-outcome events $\set{1}, \set{2}, \ldots, \set{6}$.
The events $\set{1, 2}$ and $\set{5, 6}$ from @exm-mutually-exclusive
do not partition $\samplespace$: their union leaves out 3 and 4.

:::
